hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q '^git push' || exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run /security-audit before pushing. Once the audit passes, retry the push."}}'
